name: getresuid32
description: getresuid32 returns the real user ID, effective user ID, and saved set-user-ID of the calling process, supporting 32-bit user IDs. It is a variant of getresuid introduced for handling larger ID values.

parameters.name: ruid
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable to store the real user ID

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable to store the effective user ID

parameters.name: suid
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable to store the saved set-user-ID

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: One of the arguments specified an address outside the calling program’s address space
